Sa'an nan samfurin yana bincike a cikin Mushaf gaba ɗaya, yana karanta tafsirin aya a Dorar kafin ya kawo ta, yana bincika littafin hadisai don samun hadisai sahihai da hasan, kuma yana rubuta amsar daga waɗannan tushe kaɗai.
